lines.trans: What are you going to manage there?
These are all my people.
You will not manage them, is that clear?
No, I will manage them.
Take the champagne and go away from here.
Well why, leave it here.
Quickly take this champagne away from here.
And I told you, leave it, otherwise I will fire you.
You two had a hard breakup.
That is why it gives you no peace.
Thank you, friend, you explained everything clearly to me.
That way you will gradually forget her.

meanings.en: to intend, to plan, to be going to
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'обираться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'are going to', paired with 'собраться'.

examples.trans: I am planning to move.

examples.text: Ну и что? Я всё равно переезжать собираюсь.
examples.trans: So what? I'm planning to move anyway.
I'm planning to move anyway.
